summary: Filters audio channels with low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or band-reject behavior using frequency, resonance, and rolloff controls.
key_concepts: Audio Filter CHOP removes high frequencies, low frequencies, both outside a band, or a selected mid-frequency range.
Filter Type chooses low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or band-reject behavior.
Cutoff frequency is the half-power point where the filtered wave is reduced to half power.
Rolloff controls how sharply frequencies outside the pass band are reduced.
The second input can provide cutoff modulation channels for dynamic filter movement.

key_params.name: drywet
key_params.note: Blend filtered output with the dry input

key_params.name: filter
key_params.note: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or band-reject filter type

common_gotchas: Frequency values depend on the chosen unit mode and source sample rate.
High resonance can create sharp peaks or clipping.
Band-pass and band-reject workflows often need gain compensation after filtering.
For graphic or parametric EQ workflows, Audio Band EQ or Audio Para EQ may be a better fit.
